text:
For your 40-minute train commute, I recommend podcasts that offer concise, engaging literary discussions. "The New York Times Book Review" provides excellent author interviews and book summaries that fit well within a short timeframe. "99% Invisible" is not literature-focused but offers high-quality storytelling if you want a break from fiction. For book club discussions, "The Bookworm" or "Literary Friction" are great choices as they delve into both classic and contemporary works with accessible analysis.

The meal that comes second in the day, after breakfast, is lunch.
